_comment: Expansion 3 part D.1: the cantrips of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md).

acid_splash.name: Acid Splash
acid_splash.text: An acid bubble bursts at a point up to 60 feet away; everything within five feet of it must dodge or be eaten at. The damage grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

blade_ward.name: Blade Ward
blade_ward.text: A turning of the hand that spoils aim: every attack roll made against you loses 1d4 for a minute (concentration).

eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch_blast.text: A crackling beam of force at a foe up to 120 feet away, 1d10 on a hit. Two beams at level 5, three at 11, four at 17, each with its own roll, at one foe or several.

mind_sliver.name: Mind Sliver
mind_sliver.text: A splinter driven into a foe's mind up to 60 feet away: 1d6 psychic, and on a failed save it takes 1d4 off its next saving throw before your next turn ends. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

poison_spray.name: Poison Spray
poison_spray.text: A puff of toxic mist at a foe up to 30 feet away: a ranged spell attack, 1d12 poison on a hit. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

produce_flame.name: Produce Flame
produce_flame.text: Fire hurled from your palm at a foe up to 60 feet away: a ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire on a hit. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.text: A touch that toughens a willing ally for a minute (concentration): once a turn they take 1d4 off damage of the kind the foes here deal most.

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
shillelagh.text: A club or quarterstaff in your hand is filled with the wood's strength for a minute: you strike with your spellcasting ability, and its die becomes d8 (d10 at level 5, d12 at 11, 2d6 at 17).

sorcerous_burst.name: Sorcerous Burst
sorcerous_burst.text: Raw sorcery flung at a foe up to 120 feet away: a ranged spell attack, 1d8 of acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, psychic or thunder as you choose. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

starry_wisp.name: Starry Wisp
starry_wisp.text: A mote of starlight at a foe up to 60 feet away: a ranged spell attack, 1d8 radiant on a hit. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

thorn_whip.name: Thorn Whip
thorn_whip.text: A whip of thorns lashes a foe up to 30 feet away: a melee spell attack, 1d6 piercing, and a Large or smaller foe is dragged up to 10 feet towards you. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.text: A deafening clap that hurts everything within five feet of you, friend or foe; they must pass a Constitution save or take 1d6 thunder. It carries for 100 feet. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

toll_the_dead.name: Toll the Dead
toll_the_dead.text: A dolorous bell tolls over a foe up to 60 feet away: a Wisdom save or 1d8 necrotic, and 1d12 if it is already wounded. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

true_strike.name: True Strike
true_strike.text: One blow with the weapon in your hand, guided by insight: you strike with your spellcasting ability, radiant if that hurts more, and from level 5 it carries extra radiant dice (1d6, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17). The foe must be in the weapon's reach.

vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious_mockery.text: Insults laced with magic at a foe up to 60 feet away: a Wisdom save or 1d6 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack before its next turn ends. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

word_of_radiance.name: Word of Radiance
word_of_radiance.text: Burning light bursts from you; each foe within five feet must pass a Constitution save or take 1d6 radiant. Your friends are spared. Grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.
